_meta.description: Full cannon DTOs for Unity Cloud Save 'cannon_stats' custom-id, anchored to the LIVE cloud values provided 2026-05-24. Redesign deltas applied: maxUpgradeLevel -> 100 for all cannons; baseDamage x10 (Single 1->10 ... BigBartha 8->80). Egg tier HP is ALSO x10 in Assets/Resources/Data/EggTierConfigs (balance-neutral rescale so the integer geometric curve produces clean values without changing TTK). All other fields are the player's real cloud data, preserved verbatim.
_meta.applyInstructions: In the Cloud Save dashboard 'cannon_stats' custom-id, set each sub-key's value to the matching object below. These are complete DTOs (not a partial merge).

curveContext.note: Runtime applies the upgrade curve on top of these L1 base values — do NOT pre-bake upgraded values.
curveContext.damageCurve: damage(L) = max(damage(L-1)+1, round(baseDamage * 1.06^(L-1)))  // ceiling ≈ baseDamage * 320 at L100
curveContext.fireRateCurve: fireRate(L) = baseFireRate * (1 + 0.5 * (1 - 0.924^(L-1)))  // saturates to x1.5 by ~L30

verifiedBulletCounts.note: From prefab gunTips (CannonDatabase). NOTE: Lucky & Shotgun descriptions say RANDOM bullets (1-5 / 4-7) — gunTips gives a fixed count, so the menu DPS readout uses these as a fixed approximation. Decide whether to display avg instead.

_meta.resolved_baseDamage: Base damage scaled x10 from live cloud values (Single 1->10, Rapid 0.5->5, Lucky 2->20, Double 1.5->15, Shotgun 1.2->12, BigBartha 8->80, Triple 3->30). Egg tier HP also x10 (EggTierConfigs) so TTK/hit-counts/score are identical — only magnitudes grew, fixing fractional bases and letting the geometric curve compound cleanly from ~L20. L100 damage ≈ baseDamage * 320.
